Question: A population contains 6 items, including 3 in a specified category. Select 2 items uniformly at random without replacement. Let \(X\) be the number of selected items in that category. What is \(E[X]\)?
Solution: Each of the two draws has marginal probability \(3/6\) of being in the category. By linearity of expectation, \(E[X]=2\times(3/6)=1\). Independence of the draws is not required.
